strongest_argument: I checked the four moves against the Yahoo daily bars and every one is correct: 2025-08-15 -22.7%, 2025-11-17 -8.45%, 2026-03-25 +9.6% then -11.3%, 2026-05-22 -16.5%. The arithmetic survives. The framing does not. First, the magnitude leg is already exactly in the price: the mean absolute move across those four prints is 14.3% and the baseline's event-implied move is 15.05% on a 91.4% ATM IV, so the option market has priced the precise size of reaction the claim's own history implies. Second, the interpretive leg is a wire headline, not a discovery - Investing.com published 'So-Young shares tumble 12% on wider loss despite revenue beat' on 2026-05-22, which is verbatim the claim's thesis, and the 'exceeded the high end of guidance' language is boilerplate in every quarterly release, indexed on SEC.gov, Morningstar and Barchart. Third, 'automated screens cannot recover the dates' is a statement about this repo's EDGAR item-code pass, not about the market: Investing.com, WallStreetZen and MarketBeat all maintain SY earnings-date and reaction pages, because commercial vendors build FPI calendars from press releases rather than item codes. Fourth, the options argument is inverted - 200 total contracts with a 40%-of-mid ATM spread and a skew the baseline could not compute is an empty book, and 0.11 put/call on 200 contracts is roughly 20 puts against 180 calls, one retail order. You cannot argue the book is too thin to compute skew and simultaneously thick enough to reveal complacent positioning. Finally the directional leg is statistically empty: 3-of-4 down carries a 31% probability under a fair coin, and reclassifying the +9.6% print as a loss using the next session is a post-hoc window change, not a fifth observation.

prior_publication.what_it_says: Wire story on the day of the -22.7% print, decline pinned on the swing to a non-GAAP net loss despite aesthetic revenue up 426%.
The headline states the claim's thesis outright: shares tumble on wider loss despite a revenue beat.
Q3 2025 release exhibit with 'exceeding the high end of guidance' alongside a net loss of RMB64.3m - the language is boilerplate.
Public SY earnings history page with per-quarter report dates and surprise data, refuting the claim that print dates are unrecoverable outside EDGAR.
Second public vendor page listing So-Young earnings dates back to 2015 despite the company being a 6-K filer.

baseline_evidence: Event-implied move of 15.05% sits almost exactly on the 14.3% mean absolute move of the four prints cited, so the size of an adverse reaction is fully paid for regardless of sign. The 200-contract open interest, 40%-of-mid spread and null 25-delta skew mean the book carries no positioning information either way, so the 9:1 call ratio is noise from an empty chain rather than evidence of complacency. The genuine tension with my verdict is the tape: +30.43% over 20 days into the print is not what you would expect if the market were braced for a fifth adverse reaction.
materiality: material as to reaction magnitude - 14.3% mean absolute historical move against a 3.17% deadband - but that magnitude is already the straddle. Immaterial as directional edge: 3-of-4 down is a 31% coin-flip outcome on n=4.
what_would_change_my_verdict: A computable 25-delta put skew bid on SY, or evidence that the aesthetic-centre loss line is widening again this quarter rather than narrowing as Q4 2025 and the run-up both suggest.
